§3§lPurpose and mechanism§r
Thick Grease can be collected in Prosperity's Gearwork Forest. Heat and desulfurize the feed, then distill organic chemical feedstocks and mineral by-products. Check one named raw-fluid cell filled with §11000§r mB of Thick Grease. §2The cell is not consumed§r; building the industrial line is not required.

§3§lPreparation and operation§r
Separate raw-fluid collection from heating, desulfurization, and fractionation. Keep a full raw-fluid cell for the check rather than returning with only processed intermediates. This resource starts chemical routes and mineral byproduct recovery; it does not directly grant every final product. Verify recipes, reagents, and outlets later. This goal checks only the raw-fluid cell.
